subject.title: [Feature]: Per-bot context isolation in multi-bot Feishu groups - only record context when mentioned

question: Should Feishu gain an explicit mention-only/per-bot context policy, or should `requireMention` itself stop recording unmentioned group messages into pending history?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent fix changes public Feishu config and existing group-history semantics, so automation should not choose the compatibility/default contract alone.

options.title: Add Explicit Feishu Context Policy
options.body: Introduce a default-preserving Feishu-owned policy such as mention-only context isolation, with schema/docs/tests and live multi-bot proof.

options.title: Redefine requireMention Semantics
options.body: Stop recording unmentioned messages when requireMention is true, accepting a compatibility change to current documented pending-history behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Target Attribution
options.body: Defer this Feishu-specific request to a generic multi-agent group target-attribution design such as the broader group-context issue.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Feishu Context Policy
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-preserving Feishu-owned policy such as mention-only context isolation, with schema/docs/tests and live multi-bot proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-code owner for the Feishu pending-history record/replay path and contextVisibility docs involved in the default/compatibility choice.
